mathematical_review: 6.1 sampling alias identities, Nyquist boundary counterexample, integration step distinct from sampling interval, causal filter startup and full-window delay.
6.2 full convolution and output indexing; real-spectrum DC/Nyquist scaling; leakage/zero-padding limits; Hann amplitude normalization excludes all-zero N=2 window.

6.3 zero-state linear mapping versus fixed-initial affine mapping; unilateral Laplace initial term and ROC; X(s) U*T, U(s) U, H(s) T; saturated Vmax and K units; unilateral Z indexing and ZOH k=0 limit; Euler positivity and stability.

6.4 full-column-rank OLS projection, fixed-design Gaussian assumptions; finite-grid versus continuous optimum; zero initial amount nonidentifiability; relative versus inverse-variance loss units; known-sigma confidence versus future prediction; n-2 residual degrees of freedom; iid random-pair bootstrap and finite Monte Carlo precision.

6.5 conditional-mean-zero innovation and errors-in-variables covariance; 200 independent stationary experiments; full singular-value rank/condition calculation; excitation and known physical gain units; chronological split and training-only transforms; common validation rows and single frozen test; missing timestamps preserved.
Capstone inverse-variance loss dimensionless, exact ZOH/manual indices and prediction targets; observation blue, one-step prediction pink, free-run green.
